scope: Adjacent unsubmitted Practice help source integrity only, not full-stage acceptance

regression.count_scope: 32 prior Route/scope/activity cases +2 permanent unsubmitted help cases +9 Concept cases

mechanism: Actual unsubmitted Practice hint or solution remains in exposures and native events, but its learning.action_recorded outbox is removed by controlled SQLite fault injection. Previously ConceptState read counted it; the new Learning-owned checked_action_revisions port validates the whole sequential action/outbox/progress binding before Practice builds participation. Every returned help/submission event must occur in that checked map.
boundaries: Only synthetic SQLite fixtures; no claim that normal HTTP can mutate database outbox rows.
No core model or migration changes.
No default-port service or browser tests.
Previous development and boundary-repair packages preserved unchanged.
No source changes or test reruns during packaging.
